mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review v WHERE v.v_parent_idx = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review r2 WHERE r2.v_parent_idx = v.v_idx)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review v LEFT JOIN user u ON v.u_idx = u.u_idx LEFT JOIN space s ON v.s_idx = s.s_idx

SELECT v.v_idx AS rev_idx, v.u_idx AS user_idx, u.u_name AS user_name, v.s_idx AS spc_idx, s.s_name AS spc_name, v.v_time AS rev_time, v.v_rating AS rev_rating, v.v_content AS rev_content, v.v_parent_idx AS rev_parent_idx, v.v_active AS rev_active, v.v_img AS rev_img, v.v_created_at AS rev_created_at, v.v_updated_at AS rev_updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_report rr WHERE rr.v_idx = v.v_idx AND rr.rr_status = 'PENDING') AS report_cnt, (SELECT rv.v_content FROM review rv WHERE rv.v_parent_idx = v.v_idx LIMIT 1) AS admin_reply, (SELECT rv.v_created_at FROM review rv WHERE rv.v_parent_idx = v.v_idx LIMIT 1) AS admin_reply_at FROM review v LEFT JOIN user u ON v.u_idx = u.u_idx LEFT JOIN space s ON v.s_idx = s.s_idx
ORDER BY
report_cnt DESC,
v.v_created_at DESC LIMIT #{numPerPage} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT v.v_idx AS rev_idx, v.u_idx AS user_idx, u.u_name AS user_name, v.s_idx AS spc_idx, s.s_name AS spc_name, v.v_time AS rev_time, v.v_rating AS rev_rating, v.v_content AS rev_content, v.v_parent_idx AS rev_parent_idx, v.v_active AS rev_active, v.v_img AS rev_img, v.v_created_at AS rev_created_at, v.v_updated_at AS rev_updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_report rr WHERE rr.v_idx = v.v_idx) AS report_cnt, (SELECT rv.v_content FROM review rv WHERE rv.v_parent_idx = v.v_idx LIMIT 1) AS admin_reply, (SELECT rv.v_created_at FROM review rv WHERE rv.v_parent_idx = v.v_idx LIMIT 1) AS admin_reply_at FROM review v LEFT JOIN user u ON v.u_idx = u.u_idx LEFT JOIN space s ON v.s_idx = s.s_idx WHERE v.v_idx = #{revIdx}

SELECT rr.rr_idx AS rvr_idx, rr.v_idx AS rev_idx, rr.u_idx AS user_idx, u.u_name AS user_name, rr.rr_reason AS rvr_reason, rr.rr_status AS rvr_status, rr.rr_admin_reply AS rvr_admin_reply, rr.rr_created AS rvr_created FROM review_report rr LEFT JOIN user u ON rr.u_idx = u.u_idx WHERE rr.v_idx = #{revIdx} ORDER BY rr.rr_created DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM review WHERE v_idx = #{revIdx} OR v_parent_idx = #{revIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET v_content = #{replyContent}, v_updated_at = NOW() WHERE v_parent_idx = #{revIdx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (u_idx, s_idx, v_content, v_rating, v_parent_idx, v_active, v_created_at) VALUES (#{userIdx,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{spcIdx}, #{revContent}, 0, #{revParentIdx}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET v_active = #{revActive}, v_updated_at = NOW() WHERE v_idx = #{revIdx}
